abstract: Operating guide for Helicone and its AI Gateway with the maintenance-mode status stated up front (acquired by Mintlify 2026-03-03): API key and base URL, credits vs BYOK, model-string routing and failover, sessions, properties, user ids, caching and rate-limit headers, Docker self-hosting and its security defaults, LiteLLM wiring, migration and teardown. Not archived: Helicone/helicone has commits through 2026-09; the separate ai-gateway repo has not been updated since 2025-11.
